Package arcade.patch.env.component

Class PatchComponentSites

java.lang.Object
arcade.patch.env.component.PatchComponentSites
All Implemented Interfaces:
Component, Serializable, sim.engine.Steppable
Direct Known Subclasses:
PatchComponentSitesGraph, PatchComponentSitesPattern, PatchComponentSitesSource
public abstract class PatchComponentSites extends Object implements Component
Abstract implementation of Component for patch sites.

The object defines the locations of sites from which molecules are generated and added into the environment. Multiple molecules generated from the same sites are tracked by a list of PatchComponentSites.SiteLayer objects, which map the component to the correct environment lattices.
